user.title: Connect to your Deye inverter
user.description: Enter the connection details of the inverter's datalogger (Modbus TCP).

data_description.mod: Leave this on automatic unless load and grid power read ten times too low: the variant is then derived from the rated power the inverter reports. You can change it later in the integration options.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the inverter. Check the host, port and serial number, and make sure no other client is connected to the datalogger.
error.invalid_serial: The serial number must contain only digits.

init.title: Deye inverter options
init.description: Change the power scaling variant if load, grid and CT power read ten times too low (or too high) compared with your meter.

data_description.mod: Check it with the balance PV output ≈ load + grid + battery: it only adds up on the right variant. The integration reloads when you save.

options.2: Load, grid and CT power ×10, battery current ×10 (10–12 kW, e.g. SUN-10K-SG02LP1)
